m: The teacher grips the *brush handle* and stares at the messy page with a cold, **stern face**.
Under a tall pointed *lid* the farmer stores his grain all winter: a round **silo**.
Lock the *mortise* box and bury it in the *rice field* to remember the day: a precious **keepsake**.
One *moon* and another *moon* walk side by side through the night sky: two **buddies**.
Under the *roof*, a *tossing sleeper* dreams of food and hugs an empty **rice bowl**.
A *square* stone marks the edge of the path where travellers rest at the **roadside**.
A *white dove* drops a soft *towel* woven from fine threads: a piece of **silk cloth**.
With a walking *cane* and no plan at all, the **wanderer** drifts from town to town.
A *sparrow* tied to your wrist with a *ribbon* rides along with you: a **carried bird**.
A *swaddled baby* is laid before the gods in the quiet **shrine hall** for a blessing.
A *bent knife* swings near the *trapped man* on the cliff's edge: a **teetering man** about to fall.
A *dark thread* tethers each cow to a post in the *rice field*: the farm's **livestock**.
A *cobra* slides past the farmer in the field: just an ordinary **commoner** working hard.
Something white rises out of the *rice field* at midnight: a **spook** that makes you shiver.
With each *long stride* the path goes on and on: a **stretching road** that never ends.
A *left hand* grips the *halberd* tight: the **soldier** marches to the front.
Under the *rain*, an old man strokes his dripping *beard*: **waiting in rain** for the bus.
A *pig* with little *horns* jogs down the lane: a **trotting pig** on its way to market.
*Three planks* laid across the fields mark the line between two lands: the wild **borderland**.
An *upside-down man* looks up at a dark *moon* that has vanished: it is the **new moon**.
Lie on the *sleeping mat* and feel your *heart* glow when Mum gives you a **warm hug**.
Tie a *towel* round your waist with a *cross* of string: a cook's **apron**.
A *grabbing hand* pulls the *crowd* together into one place: a big **gathering**.
*Spread feet* plant firmly on a *bean* sprout as tall as a beanstalk: up goes the **climber**.
Swinging a *cane* and humming a tune, you go for a **leisurely stroll** by the river.
A *pennant* of a tail and a head like the *sun*: a **lizard** basking on a rock.
At *dusk moon* time you can't see faces, so your *mouth* calls out: wear a **name tag**.
A *right hand* snatches the *sparrow* out of the air: a **caught bird** struggling to fly.
Under the *roof* lives a *pig*, snuggled up by the fire: it is **home**.
A *sparrow* flies up the *mountain* until it reaches the highest, **lofty peak**.
Wind a string round a *square* block and let it go: it whirls like a **spinning top**.
Down from the *hillside* walks a young man in his best suit: the **bridegroom**.
A long-legged bird stands in the tall *grass* by the lake: a grey **heron**.
The *left hand* holds the *workbench* steady while the right one works: that's your **left**.
The *shed* is full of every *cart* in town, parked in rows: a big **warehouse**.
A *standing person* in fine robes bows to the king: the noble **marquis**.
The *grain stalk* turns red as a *campfire* and is cut: it is **autumn**.
A *claw* swipes past your face and your eyes snap shut in an **eyeblink**.
A *cane* beats the dust from old clothes until they fall apart: nothing left but **rags**.
*Water drops* wash over the shore and leave a *pinch* of tiny grains: **sand**.
Under a *blanket* the baby wriggles across the *seedbed* on hands and knees: a little **crawler**.
Under the *embers* of the stove, many pots bubble: the busy **kitchen**.
Under the *roof*, a *stepladder* leads up to a little bed by the window: a **cozy room**.
Put the *king*'s portrait in an *open crate* and nail it to the wall: a **picture frame**.
The *lying man* tells stories of the *flood hero*, his great ancestor: all his **kinfolk** listen.
The *king* holds up a golden stone with a *white dove* trapped inside it: **amber**.
The *parents* chop wood with an *axe* for the winter fire: fresh **firewood**.
*Water drops* sit still on the *flat* surface of the lake, and green **pond weed** floats on top.
Open your *hand* wide and look at the lines across it: your **palm**.
A *claw* of a hand grabs the boy's collar: the lord's little **page boy** runs errands.
The *spring planter* sows seeds while the warm *sun* smiles: it is **springtime**.
Under the *moon* the weaver twists long, bendy stems into baskets: strong **rattan**.
Under the school *banner* stands the one who knows everything: your **teacher**.
The *lying man* squeezes under a *double mountain* and bends low: a **crouching man**.
Under the *tree*, the **woodcutter** lifts his *axe* and splits the log in two.
Dragging a *bundle* of borrowed food in his *backpack*, the **freeloader** never pays.
A tiny *mouth* nibbling leaves under the *moon*, spinning silk: a **silkworm**.
A *bug* so tiny you need a *fork* to catch it as it jumps: a **flea**.
Stand on the *cliff* and drop a *jade tablet* over the side: the very **cliff edge**.
*Scissors* snip silently past the *bare tree* in the dark: the **assassin** strikes.
A *standing person* hits the *gong* and points through the side gate: a quick **shortcut**.
Under the pale *moon*, a *strong arm* taps your side: a bony **rib**.
From the *sprouting field* rides a man with a *puff of breath* in the cold: a brave **knight**.
A *robe* covered in silk flowers and dragons: the beautiful **embroidered robe**.
A *white dove* drinks where clear *water* bubbles out of the ground: a fresh **wellspring**.
Put on your *summer hat* and walk with *trudging feet* through the heat: it is **summer**.
Taste the *salt* on your cheeks: your *heart* is so full it spills over in **tears**.
Throw a giant *lid* of netting across the river to catch every fish: a **dragnet**.
*Side by side*, everyone stands in the light of the *sun*: **broad daylight**.
A *white dove* lands on the head of the *king* and becomes his **golden crown**.
Under the *roof*, the whole *valley* fits inside a giant jar: what a **container**.
One *person* after another lines up on the *hillside*: a whole **team**.
A *big man* draws a huge *bow* across his chest: the **bowman** takes aim.
The *spring planter* lifts his best basket up to the emperor: a humble **tribute**.
An *eyebrow* shoots up above the *eye* in surprise: a **raised brow**.
Cut the *grass* with *scissors* and hang it up to dry: bitter **mugwort**.
*Joined hands* bow down together before the altar, side by side: a **kneeling pair**.
A row of loops like a *picket fence* holds up your trousers: your **belt**.
A robe so long it drags on the *soil* behind you: a **long robe**.
A *woman* shouts into the cave and the cave's *mouth* shouts back: an **echo**.
The *winnowing basket* is ripped in two by an *axe*: a loud **tearing** sound.
*Water drops* soak the *seedbed* by the river where brown fuzzy stalks grow: **cattail**.
A *woman* pins up her hair and takes her husband's hand: his **wife**.
The *assistant* sets a pot over the *embers*, and up comes the **rising steam**.
The *left hand* drops a coin to the *cub*, who saves it in his **piggy bank**.
Up past the *gate*, the *visitor* climbs a ladder into the **loft**.
The *rice field* is buried under a *silk skein* that keeps unrolling: a huge **yarn pile**.
*Feathers* spread wide like *thick hair* in the wind: **soaring wings** high above.
Air flows through your *nose* and calms your *heart*: one deep **breath**.
The *tiger* crouches low under the *small table*, ready to pounce: a **crouching tiger**.
A baby *sheep* curls up and warms itself by the *embers*: a fluffy little **lamb**.
Hit the *drum* so hard that its *bristles* shake: **drumbeat** after drumbeat fills the hall.
The *twins* and a *white dove* all join the dance: everyone, **all together**.
The *scholar* passes his exam and pounds the **joy drum** for the whole town to hear.
Water keeps pouring into the *dish* until it runs over the edge: a **spilling dish**.
Pull a *towel* out of the *open crate* and wrap it round your forehead: a **headband**.
The *axe* is put away and a *yawn* turns into a big happy **grin**.
The *road* splits again and again, and *rice* grains you dropped are gone: a **lost traveller**.
Under the *roof*, *troops* stand to attention for the **guest of honour**.
The *shape-shifter* throws a *cross* of sparks into the sky: bang, **fireworks**.
*Leaf pickers* climb high into the *tree* to feed the silkworms: the **mulberry**.
A *pit* hidden under crossed *scissors* of sticks: a deadly **booby trap**.
Bent over the *grass* with a sickle from dawn to dusk: the tired **labourer**.
Wrap your fingers like a *blanket* round some *rice*: a **handful of rice**.
Down the dusty *road* gallops the *envoy*'s fastest messenger: the **dispatch rider**.
A *claw* dips into the *mortar* and lifts out a **rice scoop**.
The **blacksmith** swings his *war club* and pounds red-hot iron on the anvil.
A *skeleton* and a *spoon* lie in the earth under a stone: a quiet **grave**.
On the *podium* under the *cliff*, a mother holds up her **newborn**.
Strike the hanging stone shaped like an *eyebrow* and it rings: a **chime stone**.
At the *mountain pass* by the *hillside*, the **pitcher** throws a perfect fastball.
*Water drops* and scraps from the *footprint field* all go into the pigs' **slop bucket**.
A *sparrow* with a white *towel* round its neck stretches up tall: a graceful **crane**.
*Grey hair* and a nervous *puff of breath*: the old student sits his final **exam**.
Over the *wavy river*, a basket shaped like a *fruit* hangs in the tree: a bird's **nest**.
*Silk thread* wrapped round a *warm bowl* to keep it hot: soft **cotton padding**.
A *tree* planted inside a *fence* that is too small: a **trapped tree**.
The *prowling dog* thinks it is the *king* and barks at the moon: a **mad dog**.
*Water drops* splash as the *birdsong* fills the bathroom: time for a **bath**.
The *hillside* gives way, *holding meat* and all, in a roaring **landslide**.
